evidence_basis: Introduction, methods, results text and captions were scanned by keyword and the passages quoted were read; the discussion was not read. DITPA, not Triac, is the analogue tested.

Locator L1 (Abstract (text cut at the source line); for: DITPA (not Triac) promotes human OL differentiation transcripts in hESC-derived OPC cultures): "treatment of these cultures with DITPA (an MCT8-independent TH analog), up-regulates OL differentiation transcr"

Locator L2 (Fig. 5 legend; for: Differentiation medium of the hESC-OPC system contains T3: a T3-deprived control is needed in any TH-analogue test): "Cells were treated with either T3 alone (T3, 50 ng/mL), DITPA alone (DITPA, 10 ng/mL) or T3 with DITPA (T3, 50 ng/mL + DITPA, 10 ng/mL)"

Locator L3 (Fig. 1 legend; for: T3 promotes terminal differentiation of human OPCs in vitro): "(i, j) T3 promoted terminal differentiation of OPCs into (i) O4 + pre-OLs (stage VI), and (j) MBP + pre-myelinating OLs."

Locator L4 (Results; for: Same TH-signalling readout under T3 and DITPA in this system): "Further analysis revealed no significant differences in the gene expression for THRB, DIO2 and DIO3, between T3 and DITPA treatments"
